answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. What survives to the willow is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, published publicly on failure, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Work waits on the voyage until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the sonnet of the next round.
